I want all guns on the target now!|audio = VoidcoreWave48-3.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 48 ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Void Swordmaster''' is a major boss from the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes, spawning on Wave 43 and Wave 48 respectively. It has the highest health of all enemies that appeared before it and a slightly slow speed, eventually speeding up to be average. The '''Void Swordmaster''' has three abilities: #The first is ''Void Tear'', where the '''Void Swordmaster''' slices the ground, creating four lines of four explosions forming a cross. Any tower hit by an explosion gets stunned for 10 seconds while units receive 150 damage. The '''Void Swordmaster''' itself will also gain [[Health Regen]] for 5.67 seconds while performing this. #The second is ''Impaling Sword'', where the '''Void Swordmaster''' impales the ground, creating multiple explosions that apply a 150% [[Fatigue Debuff]] and 12.5% [[Scared Debuff]], which both last for 17.5 seconds. This ability also deals 500 damage to units and can hit up to 25 towers. #The third is ''Undying Will'', which triggers at half health. The '''Void Swordmaster''' gains 150,000 [[Shield Health]], a 50% speed boost, and has its ''Impaling Sword'' cooldown halved. ==Logbook Description== "''The Void Sword Master is the commander of the Void Knights. Guided by the Void, he is deadly in his art. Void Caster, surprisingly, did not create the Void Sword Master. She found him. He’s a remnant of the Old World who had already made a name for himself, but he had no purpose to achieve. Seeing an opportunity, the Void Caster gave him one. The Void Sword Master does not speak often, and there is no record of him losing a fight. (Until today.) Void Caster trusts him completely, but even she does not know the extent of what he is capable of. Instead, she has decided there is not a need to.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Swordmaster''' has a black, muscular body and a glowing purple face. There are many spots on its body which are glowing purple. It wears a purple robe with gold accents and runes written on it, a black and gold belt, a gold armband on its left arm and a gold crown. On its back it carries two swords which it uses to attack towers and units with. ==Strategy== *The '''Void Swordmaster''' is widely considered one of the greatest run-killers in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. It should be treated as a high priority target. *High DPS towers like the [[Juggernaut]]. [[Accelerator]] or [[Turret]] are recommended for use against the '''Void Swordmaster'''. **Towers like the [[DJ Booth]], [[Commander]], and [[Medic]] can be used to enhance the DPS of those towers. *Do not underestimate the '''Void Swordmaster's''' speed, as it is one of the bosses with the fastest base speed, especially after using the ability ''Undying Will''. **Towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Cryomancer]] and [[Sledger]] cannot freeze the '''Void Swordmaster''', but they can add chill to it, slowing it down and giving more time to attack. ***Towers that apply stun, like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Tesla]] and [[Warden]] can slow it too, yet these are less reliable either due to their stun times being quite low or, in the case of the [[Warden]], the '''Void Swordmaster's''' size reducing it significantly. *The [[Medic]] can be used to protect towers from the '''Void Swordmaster's''' ''Void Tear'' ability, as it stun time is rather long. **Do note that, although it can be used to protect from stuns, it cannot grant immunity to debuffs such as those from the ''Impaling Sword'' ability. *It is recommended to temporarily set one or two of your DPS towers to target the ''Last'' or the ''Weakest'' enemy to dispose of the [[Void Cultist]]s that accompany the '''Void Swordmaster'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Void Swordmaster''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HardcoreReworkPI4.png|'''Void Swordmaster''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidSwordmasterCA.jpg|'''Void Swordmaster''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} DefeatVoidSwordmasterBadge.png|'''Void Swordmaster''' on its badge. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidSwordmasterIconIG.png|'''Void Swordmaster''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Swordmaster''' is based on the [[Fallen Swordmaster]] from the original [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, who in turn was based on the [[Swordmaster]] from the [[SFOTH Event]]. *The concept art of the '''Void Swordmaster''' is created by [https://www.roblox.com/users/445244958/profile DaddyDonuts]. * The '''Void Swordmaster''' is based on [https://darksouls3.wiki.fextralife.com/Pontiff_Sulyvahn Pontiff Sulyvanh] from ''Dark Souls 3'', Xeroc from the ''Calamity Mod'', and [[wp:Gorr the God Butcher|Gorr the God Butcher]].[[File:Voidswordproof.png|280px]] *The '''Void Swordmaster''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Swordmaster''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Void Swordmaster''' will appear as unlocked in the [[Index]], but players will be unable to summon it in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode without Sandbox Plus+. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Health increased from 650,000 to 700,000 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. **Speed decreased from Slightly Slow (2) to Slow (1.75). **''Void Tear'' now gives the '''Void Swordmaster''' [[Health Regen]] for 5.67 seconds. **''Impaling Sword'' changed. ***Blade count increased from 15 to 25. ***[[Fatigue Debuff]] increased from 50% to 150%. ***Debuff durations decreased from 45 to 17.5. ***Damage increased from 200 to 500. ***Cooldown decreased from 40 to 35. **''Undying Will'' [[Shield Health]] increased from 100,000 to 150,000. ==Notes== {{Hardcore|[[Void Knight]] & [[Void Trickster]]|Wave 42|Void Swordmaster|Wave 43|[[Void Guardian]]|Wave 44}} {{Voidcore|[[Void Knight]]|Wave 47|Void Swordmaster|Wave 48|[[Void Guardian]]|Wave 49}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
